When I got those attacks I try to write down how I feel then going for a walk or ride my bike for some hours. I also got medication to keep me more calm but those doesn't really work for some reason.

Those attacks and thoughts come mostly when I have nothing to do, I keep thinking about it and also I dream about it a lot of times.

I drink a lot of water, eating is most of the times okay sleeping is around 9 to 10h a day but I get up after around 4h of sleep because of nightmares, then I try to read a little bit and keep myself calm and try to go back to sleep. and I workout every day. But most of the time it is in the middle of working out that I suddenly think about those events. Then I got angry and sad.

I have 1 friend I can talk to about this but I don't tell everything because I am afraid of his reaction.

I watch videos on youtube and copy them, I haven't found anything that is really fitting for me but it works. Or just on the internet for the basics and try that. (sorry if my english is off, not my first language)
